definitions.explanation: Describes an institution (school, hospital, museum, park, etc.) that is established and operated by a prefectural government. Used as a prefix to the institution name.

examples.japanese: {県立|けんりつ}{高校|こうこう}に{通|かよ}う。
examples.english: To attend a prefectural high school.

examples.japanese: {県立|けんりつ}{美術館|びじゅつかん}で{展覧会|てんらんかい}が{開|ひら}かれている。
examples.english: An exhibition is being held at the prefectural art museum.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{県立|けんりつ}{病院|びょういん}で{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: My son was born at a prefectural hospital.

notes:
Composed of {県|けん} (prefecture) + {立|りつ} (established). Functions as a prefix to institution names, indicating that the institution is funded and operated by a prefectural government.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県立|けんりつ}{高校|こうこう}: prefectural high school
- {県立|けんりつ}{病院|びょういん}: prefectural hospital
- {県立|けんりつ}{美術館|びじゅつかん}: prefectural art museum
- {県立|けんりつ}{図書館|としょかん}: prefectural library
- {県立|けんりつ}{公園|こうえん}: prefectural park

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国立|こくりつ}: national (government-run)
- {市立|しりつ}: municipal (city-run)
- {都立|とりつ}: metropolitan (Tokyo-run)
- {府立|ふりつ}: prefectural (Osaka/Kyoto — for {府|ふ} rather than {県|けん})
- {私立|しりつ}: private (privately run)
- {公立|こうりつ}: public (any level of government)
